intent: A camera paused for 4 s and resumed as LiveKit sends it. Sequence numbers and picture IDs follow on with no gap. Only the timestamp, re-based to the wall clock, carries the 4 s. The frames read in the 700 ms after the resume come 300 ms late, as a paced key frame or a draining queue would. No loss path fires and every frame is written. RED: a writer that caps a frame step at 1 s plays the rest of the file 3 s early (timeline). RED: a writer that takes the arrival gap for a step over 3 s plays the rest of the file 300 ms late (timeline and the media span).
